name: BL-010 criteria, addendum 4: what Phase 6 follows (an ensemble of typical configs)
adds_to: bl010_criteria.json and addenda 1 to 3 - unchanged; this file only adds the rule that picks what Phase 6 tracks
rule: Committed before the ensemble is picked or its walk-forward computed. Never edited after results are seen: a change is a new file that names this one as superseded, with the reason.
reason: Owner's decision, 2026-10-06. Phase 5's single-config rule failed its walk-forward in all three baskets (picks 18.6-28.5% a year against 31-32% for the median config), so Phase 6 follows money split across several typical configs instead of one 'best'.

phase_6_ensemble.inputs: As Phase 5 (addendum 3): the 8,003 round 7 arm A configs re-scored on the point-in-time universe (data/search/round7_A/scored_pit), pre-tax, Rs 2 lakh, today's curated tags, every rebalance phase blended.

eligible.screen: Rank measure (the 25th percentile of financial-year excess over Nifty200 Momentum 30 TRI, as addendum 3) at least the median rank measure of the configs eligible so far. Plain: skip configs whose bad years were worse than the group's typical.

pick.typicality: For each screened config, its mean correlation of weekly log returns with every screened config.
pick.how: In order of typicality, most typical first, take a config if its weekly-return correlation with every config already taken is below 0.9. Stop at 4.
pick.too_few: If fewer than 3 are found, report it; the owner decides.
pick.plain: The most 'average' configs of the group, each clearly different from the others.

money.reset: Back to equal capital at the start of each financial year (April). No other transfers between configs.
money.rebalance_phase: Each config trades on one rebalance phase. Phases are assigned to spread the configs' rebalance Fridays apart (fewer orders on one day), never by past performance.

walk_forward.how: For each financial year from FY2020: apply this rule to the data ending 13 weeks before the year starts (addendum 2's embargo), hold the equal-capital ensemble through the year, and join the years. FY2019 is reported as a sensitivity ranked on January to December 2017, as in Phase 5.
walk_forward.compare: The ensemble against the median config of the same eligible group (8-12 holdings, every 2 or 4 weeks, medium basket) and against Nifty200 Momentum 30 TRI.
walk_forward.pass: Joined ensemble return at least the median config's minus 2 points a year, AND at least 5 points a year above Nifty200 Momentum 30 TRI (pre-tax; the after-tax bar is judged in the Phase 7 after-tax re-check).
walk_forward.if_killed: Report it; Phase 6 then tracks Nifty200 Momentum 30 TRI alone unless the owner decides otherwise.
walk_forward.plain: Before freezing, check that this way of picking would actually have done about as well as a typical config, year by year, without seeing the future.

phase_6_ensemble.freeze: If the walk-forward passes, the full-history pick is frozen with its config ids, rebalance phases, the code commit and the data snapshot (search.data_snapshot) before any Phase 6 step reads the hold-out or the live signal.
phase_6_ensemble.phase_6_then: The frozen ensemble takes the place of 'the frozen choice' in bl010_criteria.json phase_6_holdout: one backcast on 2012-2016, then 6 to 12 months of paper tracking next to the basket's median config and Nifty200 Momentum 30 TRI.
